name: myRep_add
prelude:
def myRep (a : α) : Nat → List α
  | 0 => []
  | n + 1 => a :: myRep a n
statement: theorem myRep_add (a : α) (m n : Nat) : myRep a (m + n) = myRep a m ++ myRep a n
proofs:
induction m with
  | zero => simp [myRep]
  | succ m ih => rw [Nat.add_right_comm, myRep, myRep, ih, List.cons_append]
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [myRep]
  | succ n ih =>
    have snoc : ∀ k, myRep a (k + 1) = myRep a k ++ [a] := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ k ihk =>
        show a :: myRep a (k + 1) = (a :: myRep a k) ++ [a]
        rw [ihk, List.cons_append]
    rw [← Nat.add_assoc, snoc, ih, snoc, List.append_assoc]
